messages.subject: reversible jump mcmc with random effect
parts:
Hello all,

Attempting to do model averaging with a random effect model, but when I attempt to configure the reversible jump MCMC settings, I get this error: "reversible jump target node "muBetaA" appears to have a non-constant hyper-parameter, which is not currently supported for reversible jump MCMC".

Anyone have any idea of how to get around this? Thanks for any assistance!
